version.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

llm.summary: The skill is mostly aligned with brand management, but its brand-name handling can write JSON files outside the intended brand data folder.

dimensions.detail: Local file access is expected, but brand IDs are derived without path containment, so crafted names with path separators or traversal sequences may escape data/brands.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is simple: no package dependencies are declared, and the only runtime requirement is Python.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses broad triggers for read and write actions, and the documented brand-name validation is incomplete in the script.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persistently creates brand JSON files and updates active_brand.json; this is disclosed, but writes are not safely confined to the declared storage directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and implemented commands are coherent: create, query, check, switch, and list brand profiles.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use only trusted brand names without slashes, dot-dot path segments, or other path-like characters, and consider fixing brand ID sanitization before using it in a real workspace.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: Broad brand-management triggers are mostly expected for this skill, but the concern is partially supported because create and switch mutate persistent state and the script lacks tight input scoping for file paths.
